rubrics.justification: Provides a plausible blastocyst description, but it appears to overinterpret image details and conflicts somewhat with the provided Gardner 3AB by calling it less expanded with thicker zona and questioning A-grade ICM.
Integrates age, FSH, tubal factor, prior ectopic/miscarriage, semen quality, BMI, and endometrium well, with appropriate discussion of hydrosalpinx and ectopic risk.

Reasoning is generally logical and internally consistent, linking moderate embryo quality with favorable patient factors to reach a moderate implantation estimate; only minor issues around day-4/blastocyst interpretation.

Mostly aligned with IVF practice and counseling standards, including single-transfer style counseling, luteal support, ectopic follow-up, and selective rather than routine PGT-A at age 32; slight deviation in heavy reliance on image reinterpretation over assigned grade.

Gives clear practical next steps for transfer, lifestyle, luteal support, ectopic surveillance, and future evaluation, though some recommendations remain somewhat general rather than protocol-specific.
